The '''''Oral History of the Republic''''' was a document written by [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]. It contained an interview with [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] about the life of [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]], and an interview with [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] about his victory against [[Norulac Freebooters]] at the [[Battle of Taanab/Legends|Battle of Taanab]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
